note: Model catalog for Settings -> Models (BUILD_BRIEF 2.3). Editable. Sizes are the Ollama download sizes (approximate); minRamGb is a comfortable minimum for this app plus the model. Not a learned artifact (listArtifacts skips this file).

embed.why: Multilingual (Finnish fragments embed well), 1024 dims, the default for finding cases by meaning.
Light and fast, English-first; for a small Mac.
Strong English retrieval quality at a mid size.

extract.why: Fills the extraction form reliably with a JSON schema; fast enough on a laptop.
Fallback when 4b is too slow on the venue Mac; weaker on long threads.
Better recall on messy threads; slower; already installed on many Macs.
Long context, different family; a cross-check for extraction.

phrase.why: Natural one-sentence questions; the validator falls back to the template on any slip.
Smoothest wording; needs a big Mac.
Small and fluent; for a Mac without much memory.
